name: Find Maximum
description: Valera has array a , consisting of n integers a 0 , a 1 , ..., a n - 1 , and function f ( x ) , taking an integer from 0 to 2 n - 1 as its single argument. Value f ( x ) is calculated by formula , where value bit ( i ) equals one if the binary representation of number x contains a 1 on the i -th position, and zero otherwise. For example, if n = 4 and x = 11 (11 = 2 0 + 2 1 + 2 3 ) , then f ( x ) = a 0 + a 1 + a 3 . Help Valera find the maximum of function f ( x ) among all x , for which an inequality holds: 0 ≤ x ≤ m .
input_specification: The first line contains integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10 5 ) — the number of array elements. The next line contains n space-separated integers a 0 , a 1 , ..., a n - 1 (0 ≤ a i ≤ 10 4 ) — elements of array a . The third line contains a sequence of digits zero and one without spaces s 0 s 1 ... s n - 1 — the binary representation of number m . Number m equals .
output_specification: Print a single integer — the maximum value of function f ( x ) for all .
approach_summary: Precompute linear sieve to store minimum prime factor (spf[x]) up to N in O(N). Factorize any number x ≤ N in O(log x) steps.
